title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Which classroom is Miku in?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like a guitar...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The others should be preparing for her anniversary party, so it must be her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This one...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong, Ichika...?
Is everything ready over there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not quite. Saki and Len have been obsessing a bit over how things should be decorated, so it might take a little while.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can see why Saki would, but Len?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, he's been overseeing how things are being laid out by pointing out how things aren't hung up straight and saying where to place decorations to “balance them out”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Len does have a keen eye for details.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
I definitely wasn't expected to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, also. Since they're going to need a little more time, Luka asked me to come talk to you and keep you company.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really appreciate it. To tell you the truth, I was getting anxious having to wait all by myself like this, and I feel much better knowing that you're here now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't realize how that can also happen to you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
On occasion.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I already know that you guys are throwing a party for me, so do I really need to wait in a different room?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, you do.
Like I said just now, Saki and Len are going all out, and I think you're gonna be blown away by what they're putting together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, I'll be looking forward to seeing that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, that reminds me. A ton of people over on our side were celebrating your anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, look. Right after the clock struck midnight, people began posting their comments and illustrations to social media.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Some even uploaded music and posted pictures of themselves cosplaying. They're all thanking you and wishing you a very happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
This is such a strange sensation.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're all wishing a different version of me a happy anniversary, but it also feels like their kindness is being directed at me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because you're both “Miku”.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something else I want to show you. Let's see... Oh, it's this video...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Hatsune Miku - Special Anniversary Show Stream Trailer”...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a preview for the show the Miku from my side's gonna do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you like to take a look at it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure. I've actually been wondering what this version of me's like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now.
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
It's me, MEIKO! The one behind the camera for this special occasion♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm here today to bring you a trailer for Miku's special anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As such, I think we should have our star tell us all about it! Let me just take this camera and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Great! I've got a good picture, so let's go and find her!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that's what this version of MEIKO's like. She doesn't quite speak the same, but her personality's pretty similar.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? MEIKO?
What are you doing walking around with that camera?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. I was thinking that I could put together a little trailer before your anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Also, the camera's rolling right now, so if you could tell our viewers out there a message...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! H-Hang on!
I was just practicing my dance routine, so my hair's probably a mess...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. I see no problem with that. If anything, it shows everyone just how hard you were working, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's just too embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, this is supposed to be a trailer. Can't you just edit this part out?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Yes, I can.

rows.Speaker: Caption
rows.Line: “Miku was just too adorable, so I decided to leave this part in♪ - MEIKO”

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience, MEIKO.
I should be ready now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Alright, give us a little message for our viewers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
It's me, Hatsune Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My special anniversary show's fast approaching and I'd like to make it one that shows just how much I appreciate all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I want it to be fun regardless of whether you're there in person or watching online!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I promise to practice very hard to sing lots of great songs for you, so stay tuned♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope we meet again during the show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all for watching!
I'll see you again on the day of her anniversary!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for showing me this, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This other version of me seems so different. I had no idea this is what she's like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When we met for the first time, I remember how startled you were, Ichika. However, now that I know what you're used to seeing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I was a bit surprised when you said, “I'm Miku”. But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No part of me doubted that.
As strange as that was, I had no problem accepting you for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? That makes me really happy. Especially since I know you love Miku songs so much, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-It does...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
Can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... You... You and the others aren't going anywhere, right, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As long as your thoughts, feelings and wishes remain, we'll be here... Along with SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember asking you something similar before, but I still sort of can't believe that I'm here talking with you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sometimes I wonder if this is all just a dream...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to see you and the girls' dream become a reality, so we won't be leaving anytime soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, you don't want us to go anywhere, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Of course!
I want you to stay for as long as possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? So, don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your feelings are closely tied to us.
So much so that we might still be here even when you're all old and gray.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, what are you guys all doing bunched up in front of the door like that? I thought you were going to tell Miku and Ichika that everything's ready.

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Len, shush!
Things are just getting good!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Those voices...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len, why'd you have to do that?
You completely blew our cover!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: M-Miku...!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa, S-Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I want you to stay forever too!
Please, don't ever leave us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry. We're not going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, back to why we're actually here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Thank you for being so patient, Miku. The party's all set.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It is? I've been looking forward to seeing how Saki and Len decorated the place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you won't believe what we did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Miku, Ichi, let's head back over!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Miku
rows.Line: Okay.
